tests.name: Canonical Dataset Integrity Test
tests.description: Golden Dataset must strictly contain all canonical verified questions (>= 2,156).

tests.name: V0 Pipeline Reproducibility Freeze Test
tests.description: Baseline V0 model must have immutable environment and pipeline hashes.

tests.name: Temporal Feature Leakage Test
tests.description: Features for predicting Year T must only look at historical data strictly <= T-1.

tests.name: Model Experiment Validation Rule
tests.description: Promoted candidate model must be validated through cross-validation and accepted.

tests.name: Minimum Training Window Test (13-Year Rule)
tests.description: No walk-forward forecast run before year 2000 is eligible for model evaluation (minimum 13 years of history required).

tests.name: Evaluation Granularity Test
tests.description: Prediction matching and scoring must strictly occur at the atomic CONCEPT level.

tests.name: Full Population Brier Calibration Test
tests.description: Calibration calculation must evaluate the full candidate population, including low-probability buckets (0-10%).

tests.name: Model Brain Integrity Test
tests.description: Model Brain must actively identify HIGH_CONFIDENCE_WRONG predictions to form adaptation hypotheses.

tests.name: Golden Dataset Immutability Test
tests.description: Historical questions must remain bit-for-bit immutable across all model simulations.

tests.name: 2026 Verification & Integration Test
tests.description: Verified 2026 examination paper must be confirmed and incorporated into historical database.

tests.name: Evidence Integrity Test (Pre-Target Bounds)
tests.description: Evidence cited for a target year T must never include questions from year >= T.

tests.name: Forecast Population Integrity Test
tests.description: Every forecasted concept must have corresponding engineered feature backing in the feature store.
